keyEvents.text: Papa Dame Ba (UD Logroñés) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Joseba Muguruza (Amorebieta) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Enrique Rivero Pérez (UD Logroñés) Substitution at 61'
Goal! Amorebieta 1, UD Logroñés 0. Xalbat Larralde (Amorebieta) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
David Navarro (UD Logroñés) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Bolo (UD Logroñés) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
